recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中可見數顆中大型、核質比高且核染色質細緻的母細胞，並混有單核球樣細胞、帶狀嗜中性球及一顆有核紅血球，呈未成熟造血細胞出現於周邊血液的樣貌，符合急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Several medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional cells with folded or kidney-shaped nuclei and more cytoplasm (monocytoid/immature myeloid cells)
A nucleated red blood cell and a band neutrophil present
Small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
Red cells show mild anisocytosis; nuclear and cytoplasmic detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and round to oval nuclei, accompanied by monocytoid/immature myeloid cells with folded nuclei, a band neutrophil, a nucleated red blood cell and a small lymphocyte. Red cells show mild anisocytosis. Auer rods and nucleolar detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with circulating blasts and immature hematopoietic cells, to be confirmed by blast enumeration and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Leukoerythroblastosis shows a spectrum of maturing myeloid cells and teardrop cells with few blasts, rather than a blast-dominant population.
CMML shows persistent monocytosis with mature monocytes and fewer than 20% blasts/promonocytes.
Lymphoblasts lack monocytoid/myeloid accompaniment and are MPO-negative and TdT-positive.
